meta_description:
64K likes, 618 comments - s8ul.esports on April 1, 2026: "Level 2. Same lobby. Different energy.
We’ve been selected for the EWC Club partner program for 2026. Out of clubs across the world, S8UL is back on the global stage for the second time. Not a fluke, we’re meant to be! 

This year feels different. We’ve prepped harder. A lot more confidence. A lot more power. 

The community made this possible. You always do.

See you at EWC. 🖤
Thank you @ewc_en for having us back. Abhi toh shuru hua hai. 🎮".
